newsitem.title: USA: Executive TeleCard gets new Taiwan order.
newsitem.headline: Executive TeleCard gets new Taiwan order.

text.p: Executive TeleCard said Monday Taiwan's Chungwa Telecom Co has said it will need a "significant increase" in the number of prepaid cards they plan to issue through the World Direct system.
Executive TeleCard said it expects to realize revenue of $4 million, net of all traffic costs, during the 2-year term of the contract with Chungwa.
Executive TeleCard said Chungwa previously issued about 560,000 prepaid cards. Chungwa was formerly known as International Telecommunications Administration.
Executive TeleCard said Chungwa's request for additional prepaid cards represents its largest paid order, outside the U.S., to date.
